skills.label: Build for Claude
skills.desc: Build a plugin people use inside Claude: an MCP connector to your product, skills for your workflows, optional MCP Apps UI, and a listing in the directory.

skills.label: Add an interactive UI to your MCP server
skills.desc: Add an MCP App to the quickstart MCP server: register a ui:// resource with the MCP Apps SDK, link it to a tool, and check that the server advertises the UI.

skills.label: Authentication for connectors
skills.desc: Meet Claude's OAuth requirements for remote MCP servers: supported authentication types, client registration, discovery, callback URLs, and token refresh.

skills.label: Blend your MCP App with Claude's theme
skills.desc: Make your MCP App's background transparent and style it with Claude's host style variables so it blends into the conversation in light and dark mode.

skills.label: Build a desktop extension with MCPB
skills.desc: Package a local MCP server as a single-click .mcpb install for Claude Desktop: when to build one, the CLI quickstart, manifest.json, and how users install it.

skills.label: Build an MCP server for Claude
skills.desc: Build a remote MCP server that people use as a connector in Claude: where it runs, authentication, what it exposes, size and timeout limits, and distribution.

skills.label: Build your first MCP server for Claude
skills.desc: Build a minimal MCP server with one tool in JavaScript, run it on your machine, and connect it to Claude Code so Claude calls your tool.

skills.label: Connector pre-submission checklist
skills.desc: Check your MCP connector against what Anthropic reviewers test, including tool design, prompt-injection patterns, and functional quality, before you submit.

skills.label: Decide what to include in your plugin
skills.desc: Decide which pieces your Claude plugin needs: an MCP connector backed by a server you host, skills, commands, agents, or UI, and how they're listed together.

skills.label: Design guidelines
skills.desc: Design MCP Apps that feel native to Claude: display modes, mobile layout, visual style, interaction patterns, and the host's style variables.

skills.label: Directory connectors vs custom connectors
skills.desc: Compare directory-listed and custom connectors: Anthropic review, in-product discovery, install links, Suggested Connectors, and per-tenant URL listings.

skills.label: Enterprise Managed Auth for connectors
skills.desc: Support auto-connect in Claude by accepting identity assertions from a customer's identity provider or from Claude, so users skip the OAuth consent step.

skills.label: Get started with MCP Apps
skills.desc: See what an MCP App can do in Claude, such as the side panel, app tools, and embedded websites, then try an example and build your own with the SDK.

skills.label: Lazy authentication for MCP servers
skills.desc: Let users call public tools immediately and defer OAuth until a protected tool is actually invoked.

skills.label: Manage your directory listing
skills.desc: Track submissions, monitor server health and usage metrics, and edit your directory listing

skills.label: Manage your listing after publishing
skills.desc: Update your MCP server, plugin, and directory listing after publication, keep your listing URL stable, and delist when you need to.

skills.label: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
skills.desc: Get oriented to the Model Context Protocol, the open standard behind Claude's connectors: local and remote servers, tools, resources, and prompts.

skills.label: Open external links from MCP Apps
skills.desc: Declare allowed link destinations so ui/open-link requests from your directory connector's MCP App open without Claude's confirmation modal.

skills.label: Submit a connector to the directory
skills.desc: Submit a remote MCP server or MCP App to the Connectors Directory through the developer portal: requirements, screenshot specs, and what each step asks for.

skills.label: Supersede older widget instances
skills.desc: Keep only the newest copy of an MCP App widget active when Claude calls its tool more than once in a conversation, using a server key and BroadcastChannel.

skills.label: Test your connector
skills.desc: Test your MCP server against Claude as a custom connector before you submit it to the directory, including a local server exposed through a tunnel.

skills.label: Troubleshoot MCP Apps
skills.desc: Debug MCP Apps in Claude with developer tools on desktop and iOS, and fix invisible apps, large tool results, iOS-only request failures, and ui.domain errors.

skills.label: Troubleshoot your connector
skills.desc: Diagnose and resolve common connection, authorization, and tool-call failures for custom and directory MCP connectors

skills.label: Add a connector that isn't in the directory
skills.desc: Connect Claude to an MCP server that isn't in the Connectors Directory, by its URL or as a local desktop extension.

skills.label: Connector verification
skills.desc: How Anthropic reviews connectors in the directory, what the Verified, Community, and Custom labels mean, and how to stay safe with third-party connectors.

skills.label: Connectors directory
skills.desc: Browse verified and community MCP connectors in the Connectors Directory, one catalog for claude.ai, Claude Desktop, mobile, Claude Code, and Cowork

skills.label: Get started with connectors
skills.desc: Connect Claude to an app or service from the Connectors directory, turn the connector on in a conversation, and manage or disconnect it later.

skills.label: GitHub integration
skills.desc: Add a GitHub repository to a conversation, or files and folders from a repository to a project, so Claude can read your code

skills.label: Gmail
skills.desc: Connect the Gmail connector so Claude can search your email and answer questions from your messages, with citations back to each one.

skills.label: Google Calendar
skills.desc: Connect the Google Calendar connector so Claude can answer questions about your meetings, attendees, and availability.

skills.label: Google Drive
skills.desc: Connect the Google Drive connector so Claude can search your Drive, read Docs, Sheets, Slides, and PDFs, and use Drive files in chats and projects.

skills.label: Microsoft 365 connector
skills.desc: Connect SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams to Claude so it can search, analyze, and act on your Microsoft 365 information

skills.label: Slack integration
skills.desc: Install the Claude app in your Slack workspace, and let Claude search Slack with the Slack connector

skills.label: Authenticate to MCP servers behind a tunnel
skills.desc: Make OAuth sign-in work for MCP servers reached through an MCP tunnel when the authorization server or identity provider is inside your network.

skills.label: MCP tunnels
skills.desc: Connect Claude to MCP servers inside your private network without opening inbound firewall ports or exposing the servers to the internet.

skills.label: Set up an MCP tunnel
skills.desc: Create a Tunnels API key, deploy the MCP tunnel stack with Helm or Docker Compose, verify the connection, and add tunneled MCP servers as custom connectors.

skills.label: Troubleshoot MCP tunnels
skills.desc: Fix MCP tunnel problems: cloudflared won't connect, tools don't appear, routing and IP validation errors, TLS and certificate failures, and OAuth errors.

skills.label: Publish to the directory
skills.desc: Submit a plugin or MCP connector to Anthropic's directory: the two submission kinds, who can submit, what review involves, and where to start.

skills.label: Track your directory submission
skills.desc: Look up the status the developer portal shows for a plugin bundle or MCP connector submission: what it means, who acts next, and who to contact.

skills.label: Connectors, skills, and plugins
skills.desc: Choose how to customize Claude: MCP connectors give it access to your tools, skills teach it how you do a task, and plugins package both as one install.

skills.label: Welcome
skills.desc: Connect Claude to your tools, teach it how your team works, and put it to work in Slack, on your desktop, in Microsoft 365, or through the Claude API.

skills.label: Build your first plugin
skills.desc: Build a plugin with one skill and an optional MCP connector, test it in Claude Code, validate it, and push it to GitHub, ready to submit your own.

skills.label: Create a plugin with Claude
skills.desc: Make a plugin for your own workflow from claude.ai or the desktop app without writing files: choose Create with Claude and answer Claude's questions.

skills.label: Manage plugins for your organization
skills.desc: Control which plugins members of your Team or Enterprise organization can use in claude.ai and Cowork: see what you have, add your own, and set availability.

skills.label: Plugin feature support across platforms
skills.desc: Look up which plugin components and install paths work in claude.ai chat, Cowork, and Claude Code, and why a plugin behaves differently on each.

skills.label: Plugin pre-submission checklist
skills.desc: Fix every finding before you submit a plugin to the Claude plugin directory: what the developer portal's validation and scan check, and what each result means.

skills.label: Plugin structure and testing
skills.desc: Reference for the plugin folder: what each file is, the manifest fields every app reads, bundling an MCP connector with its skill, and testing on each app.

skills.label: Plugins
skills.desc: Add plugins to Claude: what a plugin adds, where to find and install one, and where it's available across chat, Cowork, and Claude Code.

skills.label: Roll out a plugin to your whole organization
skills.desc: Get your organization's plugin to members in claude.ai and Cowork and to developers in Claude Code by using organization settings and managed settings together.

skills.label: Share a plugin with teammates
skills.desc: Share a plugin you made with specific people in your Team or Enterprise organization, or publish it to your organization's library.

skills.label: Submit your plugin
skills.desc: Submit a plugin from a GitHub repository to Anthropic's directory through the developer portal, follow its review, publish it, and release updates.

skills.label: Sync your organization's plugins from a repository
skills.desc: Distribute your organization's plugins from a GitHub or GitLab repository through organization settings, including repository requirements and GitLab setup.

skills.label: Create custom skills
skills.desc: Create a custom skill for Claude: write the SKILL.md file, add resources and scripts, package the skill, and test it.

skills.label: Skills overview
skills.desc: Find, turn on, and use skills: directories of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads to handle specific tasks
